entries.title: Psalms 37:1
segments: ¶<Of David.> Do not be angry because of the wrongdoers, or have envy of the workers of evil.

entries.title: Psalms 37:2
segments: For they will quickly be cut down like grass, and become dry like the green plants.

entries.title: Psalms 37:3
segments: Have faith in the Lord, and do good; be at rest in the land, and go after righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 37:4
segments: So will your delight be in the Lord, and he will give you your heart's desires.

entries.title: Psalms 37:5
segments: Put your life in the hands of the Lord; have faith in him and he will do it.

entries.title: Psalms 37:6
segments: And he will make your righteousness be seen like the light, and your cause like the shining of the sun.

entries.title: Psalms 37:7
segments: ¶Take your rest in the Lord, waiting quietly for him; do not be angry because of the man who does well in his evil ways, and gives effect to his bad designs.

entries.title: Psalms 37:8
segments: Put an end to your wrath and be no longer bitter; do not give way to angry feeling which is a cause of sin.

entries.title: Psalms 37:9
segments: For the evil-doers will be cut off: but those who have faith in the Lord will have the earth for their heritage.

entries.title: Psalms 37:10
segments: For in a short time the evil-doer will be gone: you will go searching for his place, and it will not be there.

entries.title: Psalms 37:11
segments: But the gentle will have the earth for their heritage; they will take their delight in peace without measure.

entries.title: Psalms 37:12
segments: The sinner has evil designs against the upright, lifting up the voice of wrath against him.

entries.title: Psalms 37:13
segments: He will be laughed at by the Lord, who sees that his day is coming.

entries.title: Psalms 37:14
segments: The evil-doers have taken out their swords, their bows are bent; for crushing the poor, and to put to death those who are upright in their ways.

entries.title: Psalms 37:15
segments: But their swords will be turned into their hearts, and their bows will be broken.

entries.title: Psalms 37:16
segments: The little which the good man has is better than the wealth of evil-doers.

entries.title: Psalms 37:17
segments: For the arms of the evil-doers will be broken: but the Lord is the support of the good.

entries.title: Psalms 37:18
segments: The days of the upright are numbered by the Lord, and their heritage will be for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 37:19
segments: They will not be shamed in the evil time, and in the days when all are in need of food they will have enough.

entries.title: Psalms 37:20
segments: But the wrongdoers will come to destruction, and the haters of the Lord will be like the fat of lambs, they will be burned up; they will go up in smoke, and never again be seen.

entries.title: Psalms 37:21
segments: ¶The sinner takes money and does not give it back; but the upright man has mercy, and gives to others.

entries.title: Psalms 37:22
segments: Those who have his blessing will have the earth for their heritage; but those who are cursed by him will be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:23
segments: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and he takes delight in his way.

entries.title: Psalms 37:24
segments: Even if he has a fall he will not be without help: for the hand of the Lord is supporting him.

entries.title: Psalms 37:25
segments: I have been young, and now am old, but I have not seen the good man without help, or his children looking for bread.

entries.title: Psalms 37:26
segments: All the day he is ready to have mercy and to give; his children are a blessing.

entries.title: Psalms 37:27
segments: Be turned from evil, and do good; and your place will be for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 37:28
segments: For the Lord is a lover of righteousness, and takes care of his saints; they will be kept safe for ever; but the seed of the evil-doers will be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:29
segments: The upright will have the earth for their heritage, and will go on living there for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 37:30
segments: The mouth of the good man says words of wisdom; the talk of his tongue is of righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 37:31
segments: The law of his God is in his heart; he will never make a false step.

entries.title: Psalms 37:32
segments: The sinners are watching the upright man, desiring to put him to death.

entries.title: Psalms 37:33
segments: The Lord will not give him into their hands, or be against him when he is judged.

entries.title: Psalms 37:34
segments: ¶Be waiting for the Lord, and keep his way; and you will be lifted up, and have the land for your heritage: when the evil-doers are cut off, you will see it.

entries.title: Psalms 37:35
segments: I have seen the evil-doer in great power, covering the earth like a great tree.

entries.title: Psalms 37:36
segments: But he came to an end, and there was no sign of him; I made a search for him and he was not there.

entries.title: Psalms 37:37
segments: Give attention to the good man, and take note of the upright; because the end of that man is peace.

entries.title: Psalms 37:38
segments: But as for the sinners, they will be cut off together; the end of the wrongdoers is destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 37:39
segments: But the Lord is the saviour of the upright: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 37:40
segments: And the Lord will be their help, and keep them safe: he will take them out of the hands of the evil-doers, and be their saviour, because they had faith in him.
